title: Stack Tester is failing in the past hour
description:
Dashboard link https://aka.ms/antaresdashboard?stampName=[stampName]


Useful Kusto queries (non saw) https://aka.ms/antareskustoqueries?stampName=[stampName]


GeoMaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/[cloud]%2520Geomaster%2520Check


Runners Dashboard: https://portal.microsoftgeneva.com/dashboard/WAWS/Runners/Runners%2520Performance **Please set the Region parameter accordingly**


Check Diagnostics -> Troubleshooting Guide section on the left hand side for TSG link to EngineeringHub

primaryKustoQuery.title: Failing Stack Testers
primaryKustoQuery.kustoQuery:
// Stack Tester is failing in the past hour
  let flexConsumptionFunctionsSLASitesToIgnore = (
  RunnersV2PingResultsTable
  | where Name startswith "sla-ws-func"
  | where Name contains "-fc-"
  | distinct Name);
  let rgFuncSLASitesToIgnore = (
  RunnersV2PingResultsTable
  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(3h)
  | where SiteType != "Canary"
  | where Name startswith "rg-sla-"
  | where Name has "-func-"
  | distinct Name);
  let XenonStampsToIgnore = RoleInstanceHeartbeat
  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(3h)
  | where RoleInstance startswith "x" or Role startswith "ax"
  | where BuildVersion startswith "103.0.7."
  | extend BuildNumber = toint(substring(BuildVersion, 8, 3))
  | where BuildNumber < 206
  | summarize by EventPrimaryStampName;
  let StampsToIgnoreJavatomcat = RoleInstanceHeartbeat
  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(3h)
  | where BuildVersion startswith "103.0.7."
  | extend BuildNumber = toint(substring(BuildVersion, 8, 3))
  | where BuildNumber < 172
  | summarize by EventPrimaryStampName;
  let start = ago(80m);
  let end = ago(20m);
  let GetResults = (prevFailures: (*), start: datetime, stop: datetime, AvailabilityThreshold: int, isFirstInterval: bool) {
      RunnersV2PingResultsTable
      | where TIMESTAMP between (start .. stop)
      | where Name in (prevFailures) or isFirstInterval
      | where StampName !contains "msftint"
      | where Role !contains "tester"
      | where SiteType == "Hot" or SiteType == "SCM"
      | summarize
          Availability  = round(100 * todouble(countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy")) / count(),2)
          by Url, Name, RunnerName
      | where Availability <= AvailabilityThreshold
      | where Name !in (flexConsumptionFunctionsSLASitesToIgnore)
      | distinct Name
  };
  let 15MinutesFailures = GetResults((RunnersV2PingResultsTable | take 0), end - 15m, end, 0, true);
  let 30MinutesFailures = GetResults(15MinutesFailures, end - 30m, end - 15m, 0, false);
  let 45MinutesFailures = GetResults(30MinutesFailures, end - 45m, end - 30m, 50, false);
  let transientFailures = GetResults((RunnersV2PingResultsTable | take 0), start, end, 70, true);
  let logicAppsNameToIgnore = RunnersV2PingResultsTable
  | where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
  | where Name contains "logicapps"
  | distinct Name;
  let results = RunnersV2PingResultsTable
  | where TIMESTAMP between ((start) .. (end))
  | where Name in (45MinutesFailures) or Name in (transientFailures)
  | summarize
      TotalPingCount = count(),
      FailedPingCount = countif(HealthStatus == "Unhealthy"),
      SuccessPingCount = countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy"),
      Availability  = round(100 * todouble(countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy")) / count(),2),
      SSLConnectionError1308 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1308)) / count(),2),
      DNSError1307 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1307)) / count(), 2),
      UnknownError1306 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1306)) / count(),2),
      BadRequest400s = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus >= 400 and SlaStatus < 500)) / count(),2),
      ServiceUnavailable500s = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus >= 500 and SlaStatus < 600)) / count(),2),
      TcpTimeoutError1409 = round(100 * todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1409)) / count(),2),
      ThirtySecTimeout1408 = round(100 * todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1408)) / count(),2)
      by Url, Name, RunnerName
  | where Availability <= 90
  | where FailedPingCount >= 20
  | project Name, Url, Availability = strcat(Availability, "%"), TotalPingCount, FailedPingCount, SuccessPingCount, SSLConnectionError1308 = strcat(SSLConnectionError1308, "%"), DNSError1307 = strcat(DNSError1307, "%"), UnknownError1306 = strcat(UnknownError1306, "%"), BadRequest400s = strcat(BadRequest400s, "%"), ServiceUnavailable500s = strcat(ServiceUnavailable500s, "%"), TcpTimeoutError1409 = strcat(TcpTimeoutError1409, "%"), ThirtySecTimeout1408 = strcat(ThirtySecTimeout1408, "%"), RunnerName;
  let StampNameFromFrontEnd = AntaresIISLogFrontEndTable
  | where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
  | distinct S_sitename, EventPrimaryStampName, ServerRouted // Remove later: Java JIT addition ServerRouted
  | join kind = inner results on $left.S_sitename == $right.Name
  | distinct Name = Name, StampNameFF = EventPrimaryStampName, RoleInstanceIP=ServerRouted; // Remove later: Java JIT addition RoleInstanceIP
  let slaSiteDeploymentsRecent =
  All("AntaresCloudDeploymentEvents")
  // | where TIMESTAMP between ( start-2d..end)
  | where TIMESTAMP between (start-7d..end) and TIMESTAMP < datetime(2024-11-11)
  | where Details contains "Action (Create SLA sites for a single stamp) completed"
  | distinct EnvironmentName;
  RunnersV2PingResultsTable
  | where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
  | where StampName !contains "msftint"
  | where StampName !contains "waws-prod-am2-033"
  | where StampName != "waws-prod-db3-089"
  | where Role !contains "tester"
  | where SiteType == "Hot" or SiteType == "SCM"
  | where Name !startswith "wireserver"
  | where not(Name contains "tomcat8dot5" and (Location contains "china" or Location contains "usgov"))
  | where not(Name contains "xenon" and StampName in (XenonStampsToIgnore))
  | where not(Name contains "javatomcat" and StampName in (StampsToIgnoreJavatomcat))
  | where Name !in (logicAppsNameToIgnore)
  | where Name !in (flexConsumptionFunctionsSLASitesToIgnore)
  | where Name !in (rgFuncSLASitesToIgnore)
  | where HealthStatus == "Unhealthy" and SlaStatus != 1408
  | summarize ActivityIds = strcat_array(make_list(ActivityId), ",") by Name
  | join kind=inner results on $left.Name == $right.Name
  | join kind=inner StampNameFromFrontEnd on $left.Name == $right.Name
  | where StampNameFF !in (slaSiteDeploymentsRecent) or RunnerName contains "functions"
  | project Name, Url, Availability, TotalPingCount, FailedPingCount, SuccessPingCount, SSLConnectionError1308, DNSError1307, UnknownError1306, BadRequest400s, ServiceUnavailable500s, TcpTimeoutError1409, ThirtySecTimeout1408, PrimaryActivityIds = ActivityIds, TitlePrefix = RunnerName, StampName = StampNameFF, RoleInstanceIP // ANT104 Java JIT addition RoleInstanceIP
  | extend CorrelationId = StampName, SliceOverride = StampName, TsgId = "https://eng.ms/docs/cloud-ai-platform/devdiv/serverless-paas-balam/serverless-paas-benbyrd/app-service-web-apps/antares-trouble-shooting-guides-tsg/tsgs/alerttsgs/stacktester/mitigation"
  // ANT104 Java JIT addition remove after ANT104 cherry pick PR 12254604 gets merged and deployed
  // Only include sites where the worker did not download 30+ Java JIT installs (takes up most disk space and trashes the worker)
  | join kind=leftanti
  (
  AntaresRuntimeWorkerEvents
  | where TIMESTAMP > ago(3h)
  | where EventId == 57914
  | where Message startswith "Successfully received Jit'd framework JAVA"
  | summarize countJavaJIT=dcount(Message, 0) by StampName=Tenant, RoleInstanceIP=EventIpAddress
  | where countJavaJIT > 30
  ) on StampName, RoleInstanceIP

ussecKustoQuery.title: Failing Stack Testers
ussecKustoQuery.kustoQuery:
let start = ago(80m);
let end = ago(20m);
let GetResults = (prevFailures: (*), start: datetime, stop: datetime, AvailabilityThreshold: int, isFirstInterval: bool) {
    RunnersV2PingResultsTable
    | where TIMESTAMP between (start .. stop)
    | where Name in (prevFailures) or isFirstInterval
    | where StampName !contains "msftint"
    | where Role !contains "tester"
    | where SiteType == "Hot" or SiteType == "SCM"
    | where not(Name has_any (dynamic(["003-javase", "003-javatomcat", "003-javatomcat2", "localMySql", "php53"])))
    | summarize
        Availability  = round(100 * todouble(countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy")) / count(),2)
        by Url, Name, RunnerName
    | where Availability <= AvailabilityThreshold
    | distinct Name
};
let 15MinutesFailures = GetResults((RunnersV2PingResultsTable | take 0), end - 15m, end, 0, true);
let 30MinutesFailures = GetResults(15MinutesFailures, end - 30m, end - 15m, 0, false);
let 45MinutesFailures = GetResults(30MinutesFailures, end - 45m, end - 30m, 50, false);
let transientFailures = GetResults((RunnersV2PingResultsTable | take 0), start, end, 70, true);
let results = RunnersV2PingResultsTable
| where TIMESTAMP between ((start) .. (end))
| where Name in (45MinutesFailures) or Name in (transientFailures)
| summarize
    TotalPingCount = count(),
    FailedPingCount = countif(HealthStatus == "Unhealthy"),
    SuccessPingCount = countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy"),
    Availability  = round(100 * todouble(countif(HealthStatus == "Healthy")) / count(),2),
    SSLConnectionError1308 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1308)) / count(),2),
    DNSError1307 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1307)) / count(), 2),
    UnknownError1306 = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1306)) / count(),2),
    BadRequest400s = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus >= 400 and SlaStatus < 500)) / count(),2),
    ServiceUnavailable500s = 100 * round(todouble(countif(SlaStatus >= 500 and SlaStatus < 600)) / count(),2),
    TcpTimeoutError1409 = round(100 * todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1409)) / count(),2),
    ThirtySecTimeout1408 = round(100 * todouble(countif(SlaStatus == 1408)) / count(),2)
    by Url, Name, RunnerName
| where Availability <= 90
| where FailedPingCount >= 20
| where not(Name has_any (dynamic(["003-javase", "003-javatomcat", "003-javatomcat2", "localMySql", "php53"])))
| project Name, Url, Availability = strcat(Availability, "%"), TotalPingCount, FailedPingCount, SuccessPingCount, SSLConnectionError1308 = strcat(SSLConnectionError1308, "%"), DNSError1307 = strcat(DNSError1307, "%"), UnknownError1306 = strcat(UnknownError1306, "%"), BadRequest400s = strcat(BadRequest400s, "%"), ServiceUnavailable500s = strcat(ServiceUnavailable500s, "%"), TcpTimeoutError1409 = strcat(TcpTimeoutError1409, "%"), ThirtySecTimeout1408 = strcat(ThirtySecTimeout1408, "%"), RunnerName;
let StampNameFromFrontEnd = AntaresIISLogFrontEndTable
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| distinct S_sitename, EventPrimaryStampName
| join kind = inner results on $left.S_sitename == $right.Name
| distinct Name = Name, StampNameFF = EventPrimaryStampName;
RunnersV2PingResultsTable
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| where StampName !contains "msftint"
| where Role !contains "tester"
| where SiteType == "Hot" or SiteType == "SCM"
| where Name !startswith "wireserver"
| where HealthStatus == "Unhealthy" and SlaStatus != 1408
| summarize ActivityIds = strcat_array(make_list(ActivityId), ",") by Name
| join kind=inner results on $left.Name == $right.Name
| join kind=inner StampNameFromFrontEnd on $left.Name == $right.Name
| project Name, Url, Availability, TotalPingCount, FailedPingCount, SuccessPingCount, SSLConnectionError1308, DNSError1307, UnknownError1306, BadRequest400s, ServiceUnavailable500s, TcpTimeoutError1409, ThirtySecTimeout1408, PrimaryActivityIds = ActivityIds, TitlePrefix = RunnerName, StampName = StampNameFF
| extend CorrelationId = Name, SliceOverride = StampName, TsgId = "https://eng.core.microsoft.scloud/docs/cloud-ai-platform/devdiv/serverless-paas-balam/serverless-paas-benbyrd/app-service-web-apps/antares-trouble-shooting-guides-tsg/tsgs/alerttsgs/stacktester/mitigation"

secondaryKustoQueries.title: StatusCode Comparison between Runners and FrontEnd
secondaryKustoQueries.kustoQuery:
let start = ago(80m);
let end = ago(20m);
let PrimaryActivityIds = split("{PrimaryActivityIds}",",");
let FailRequests = RunnersV2PingResultsTable
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| where SiteType != "Canary" and SiteType != "Cold" and SiteType != "FuncCold"
| where StampName !contains "msftint"
| extend CorrelationId = StampName
| where CorrelationId == "{CorrelationId}"
| where Role !contains "tester"
| where Name !startswith "wireserver"
| where HealthStatus == "Unhealthy"
| where ActivityId  in (PrimaryActivityIds)
| project SiteName = Name, RunnerStatus = SlaStatus, ActivityId, CorrelationId;
AntaresIISLogFrontEndTable
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| where User_agent startswith "RunnersV3" and User_agent !contains "canary"
| join kind = innerunique FailRequests on ActivityId, $left.ActivityId == $right.ActivityId
| summarize ActivityIds = make_list_if(ActivityId, ActivityId == ActivityId1), count() by RunnerStatus, FrontEndStatus = strcat(Sc_status, ".", Sc_substatus, ".", Sc_win32_status), WorkerStatus = WorkerHttpStatus, SiteName, ServerRouted, CorrelationId
| project SiteName, count_, RunnerStatus, FrontEndStatus, WorkerStatus, WorkerServedRequest = ServerRouted, ActivityIds = strcat_array(ActivityIds, ","), CorrelationId

secondaryKustoQueries.title: Worker Reboot History by AzureAlerting in this stamp in the past 3 hours
secondaryKustoQueries.kustoQuery:
let start = ago(200m);
let end = now();
let Operations = AntaresAdminGeoEvents
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| where UserAgent startswith "WawsAlertingV2 - reboot bad workers hosting sla sites"
| where isnotempty(Operation)
| project Operation, ActivityId, UserAgent;
let StatusCodes = AntaresAdminGeoEvents
| where TIMESTAMP between (start .. end)
| where UserAgent startswith "WawsAlertingV2 - reboot bad workers hosting sla sites"
| where isnotempty(StatusCode)
| project StatusCode, ActivityId, TIMESTAMP;
Operations
| join kind = innerunique StatusCodes on $left.ActivityId == $right.ActivityId
| parse UserAgent with "WawsAlertingV2 - reboot bad workers hosting sla sites [" stampFromUserAgent "]"
| parse Operation with "Name: " StampName ", Request: /webadmin/machines/" RoleInstance "/" WorkerIPAddress "/" Action "?" *
| where stampFromUserAgent == "{StampName}"
| project TIMESTAMP, StampName, RoleInstance, WorkerIPAddress, Action, StatusCode
| extend CorrelationId = "{CorrelationId}"
| sort by TIMESTAMP asc
